title: Whole original CRT string duplication

0x4a48e0.name: malloc
0x4a48e0.reason: Known CRT allocation boundary per boundary role; exact requested live allocation or null, not native CRT heap/lock startup.

limits: Complete80-byte original body, required fullCPU/FS7ff/7ff and preservation472; no exemptions.

Input null or bounded readable NUL-terminated bytes with DF clear, no wrapping ranges. Input/output and fixture writes disjoint from active control stack; allocation fresh, live and nonoverlapping input, with enough backing for the actual second-scan length. Physical malloc must preserve EBP/FS and saved stack controls.

Malloc is a declared physical allocation fixture, not source CRT malloc/lock/heap acceptance. Null input skips allocation; allocation failure returns null; source string is rescanned after allocation before copying.
Whole bounded source stack and eleven CPU fields including EFLAGS are observed. No app/static initialization or device acceptance.
